content: विकाशः .²1 Manifestation, display, exhibition. .²2 Blowing, expanding (usually written विकास in this sense); बालेन्दुवक्राण्यविकाशभावाद्बभुः पलाशान्यतिलोहितानि <ls>Ku. 3. 29</ls>; विकाशः केषांचिन्नयनसुभगैर्विद्युदुदयैः <ls>Rāj. T.</ls> .²3 An open or direct course; विकाशमीयुर्जगतीशमार्गणाः <ls>Ki. 15. 52</ls>. .²4 An oblique course; <ls>Ki. 15. 52</ls>. .²5 Joy, pleasure; <ls>Ki. 15. 52</ls>. .²6 Sky, heaven (आकाश); <ls>Ki. 15. 52</ls>. .²7 Eagerness, ardent desire; युगपद्विकासमुदयाद्गमिते शशिनः शिलीमुखगणोऽलभत <ls>Śi. 9. 41</ls> (where it means ‘blowing’ also). .²8 Retreat, solitude, privacy. .²9 Brightness, radiance.
